The Subtask Name: Identify the composer of the song "How Long Has This Been Going On?"
Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: George Gershwin
Evidence: Planner confirms the composer is George Gershwin based on the song title; WebSurfer verifies this via DuckDuckGo search results showing the song was composed by George Gershwin.

The Subtask Name: Retrieve the place of death from Wikipedia
Step Range: 3-5
The Oracle: Los Angeles, California
Evidence: Planner instructs WebSurfer to open George Gershwin's Wikipedia page; WebSurfer retrieves the infobox stating "Died July 11, 1937, Los Angeles, California"; Planner notes this but seeks corroboration due to conflicting Britannica data.

The Subtask Name: Verify place of death using Britannica and resolve discrepancies
Step Range: 6-10
The Oracle: Hollywood, California
Evidence: WebSurfer attempts to load Britannica (timeout then success); Britannica shows conflicting info (Hastings-on-Hudson vs Hollywood); Planner decides to consult primary obituaries to resolve the conflict.

The Subtask Name: Consult primary newspaper obituaries for definitive place of death
Step Range: 11-19
The Oracle: Hollywood, California
Evidence: WebSurfer searches for NYT obituary; finds NYT article stating Gershwin died in Hollywood at Cedars of Lebanon Hospital; Planner notes this as definitive; WebSurfer searches for LA Times obituary to corroborate but finds limited direct text in snippets, relying on NYT and other sources confirming Hollywood.

The Subtask Name: Finalize answer and cite sources
Step Range: 20-20
The Oracle: Hollywood
Evidence: Planner synthesizes findings, prioritizing the NYT obituary which explicitly states "Hollywood, Calif." as the place of death, resolving the discrepancy with Britannica and Wikipedia.
